content:
Ravi: FYI a subset of new customers saw delayed embedding availability starting 08:05 UTC. Need a short, clear status to send and a renewal-risk flag for anyone with renewals in 30 days.
incident-bot: Incident detected: new-tenant-embed-delay at 2026-04-02 08:05 UTC.
Hannah: Quick triage: warmup parallelism drop after a scheduler tweak slowed initial indexing. No data loss; queries unaffected.
Jo: Draft outbound below. Keep it 3 bullets + action.
Jo: 
Hi there,
We wanted to let you know some newly onboarded tenants experienced a delay for embeddings/indexing between ~08:0508:35 UTC on 2026-04-02.
Impact: new documents may have taken longer than normal to appear in embeddings/search; live traffic was not disrupted and no customer data was altered.
What we did: rolled back the scheduler change and prioritized warmup; normal speeds restored by ~08:35 UTC.
Next steps: full RCA and short tech appendix in 48 hours; office hours for impacted teams tomorrow (link). If you have a renewal or launch within 30 days, reply to this thread and your CSM will prioritize follow-up.
Liam: Finance approves a standard one-day usage credit for qualifying tenants; CSMs can request exceptions.
Hannah: Ill prep a 5-slide deck and post the RCA link here when ready.
Ravi: Sending initial status to affected list now (job 334411). Jo, paste outbound to support tickets after send.
CS-bot: Attached to incident tracker incident-6076543210, owners: Ravi, Hannah, Jo.
